# LLM JavaScript API

Everything the [LLM](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/llm) extension adds to `pb_hooks` and page code, generated from the TypeScript declarations it ships (your app's `types.d.ts` has the same, so your editor knows them). For how to use it, see its docs; for Go, the [Go API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go).

## $llm

Cloud models, as $llm. $llm.for(e) is the same API with every call counted for whom the request is for (its user,
else its guest), so the limits in Settings → LLM can cap each user and each guest: pass a route's e or a page's ctx.
A call a limit refuses throws with code "limit" (429), naming the limit and when it resets.

### $llm.text

### $llm.text.completeAsync()

```ts
$llm.text.completeAsync(opts: LlmTextInput): Promise<LlmTextAnswer>
```

Answers a prompt or a conversation: model is "provider/model". With schema, the answer's data is JSON in that shape.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `opts` | `LlmTextInput` |  |

Returns `Promise<LlmTextAnswer>`.

### $llm.text.streamAsync()

```ts
$llm.text.streamAsync(opts: LlmTextInput, onText?: (text: string) => boolean | void, onReasoning?: (text: string) => boolean | void): Promise<LlmTextAnswer>
```

Like completeAsync, calling onText with each piece of the answer as it's written (false stops it).

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `opts` | `LlmTextInput` |  |
| `onText` | `(text: string) => boolean \| void` (optional) |  |
| `onReasoning` | `(text: string) => boolean \| void` (optional) |  |

Returns `Promise<LlmTextAnswer>`.

### $llm.text.count()

### $llm.image

### $llm.image.generateAsync()

```ts
$llm.image.generateAsync(opts: { model: string; prompt: string; references?: LlmFile[]; n?: number; size?: string; aspectRatio?: string; options?: Record<string, any>; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<{ files: LlmFile[]; model: string; usage: LlmUsage }>
```

Makes pictures from a prompt: n of them, at a size or aspect ratio the provider supports. references are pictures
it draws from: one to change, or one whose style and characters a new scene keeps. Only models with the feature
"reference images" take them (Vultr, OpenRouter).

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `opts` | `{ model: string; prompt: string; references?: LlmFile[]; n?: number; size?: string; aspectRatio?: string; options?: Record<string, any>; signal?: AbortSignal }` |  |

Returns `Promise<{ files: LlmFile[]; model: string; usage: LlmUsage }>`.

### $llm.search

Buckets of the app's content, searched by meaning (llm.search/v1, the llm-search extension). Only searchAsync
reaches a provider (it embeds the query); everything else is local (a URL or collection is read in the background).

### $llm.ledger

The ledger: what calls used and cost. Local reads (not provider calls), so plain. On $llm.for(e), remaining and
spent answer about that request's user or guest; on plain $llm, name a subject (or none: the whole app).

### $llm.ledger.remaining()


| `opts` | `{ subject?: string }` (optional) |  |

### $llm.onCall()

```ts
$llm.onCall(handler: (e: LlmCallEvent) => void | Promise<void>): void
```

Runs before every call that reaches a provider, every kind: change e.model, e.subject or e.input, then e.next();
or throw e.refuse("...") to refuse it. Runs before the limits in Settings → LLM, which count what it settled on.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: LlmCallEvent) => void \| Promise<void>` |  |

### $llm.onCallDone()

```ts
$llm.onCallDone(handler: (e: LlmCallDoneEvent) => void | Promise<void>): void
```

Runs after every call that reached a provider, with what it used and cost. It can't refuse; the call happened.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler` | `(e: LlmCallDoneEvent) => void \| Promise<void>` |  |

## Types

### LlmFile

A generated or sent file: data is base64. $llm.file(f) makes it a PocketBase file for record.set.

```ts
type LlmFile = { name?: string; type?: string; data?: string; url?: string }
```

### LlmUsage

```ts
type LlmUsage = { inputTokens?: number; outputTokens?: number; cachedTokens?: number; reasoningTokens?: number; seconds?: number; /** what the call cost, in millionths of a US dollar (1000000 = $1); 0 when free or not known */ costMicroUSD: number; costEstimated?: boolean }
```

### LlmModels

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `models` | `{ id: string; provider: string; type: string; name?: string; kinds: string[]; inputs?: string[]; reasoning?: boolean; contextTokens?: number; /** USD per unit ("1M input tokens", "1M output tokens", "1M cached input tokens", "1M tokens", "second", "megapixel", * "image", "1K characters", "request"): listed by the provider, or measured from this app's billed calls (calls: how * many). None: the price isn't known. */ prices?: { unit: string; usd: number; source?: "listed" \| "measured"; calls?: number }[]; description?: string; /** parameters, as its maker names them: "1.7B", "30B (3B active)" */ size?: string; /** "tools", "structured output", "vision", "audio input", "voice cloning", "voice design", "built-in voices", "lyrics" */ features?: string[]; /** ISO 639-1 codes */ languages?: string[] }[]` |  |

### LlmPassage

A passage enrich added to the prompt, from a search bucket.


### LlmEnrich

Adds the best passages from the app's search buckets after the prompt: the buckets, or { buckets, limit?, query? }.

```ts
type LlmEnrich = string[] | { buckets: string[]; limit?: number; query?: string; /** who the answer is for (ctx.auth, or null for a guest): passages from records they can't view are left out */ viewer?: core.Record | null }
```

### LlmCallEvent

A billable call on its way to a provider, as $llm.onCall handlers see it.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `"text" \| "image" \| "speech" \| "transcribe" \| "align" \| "music" \| "video" \| "embed"` |  |
| `op` | `string` | The operation: "complete", "stream", "generate", "speak", "transcribe", "align", "create" or "embed". |
| `model` | `string` | "provider/model"; change it to send the call to another model. |
| `subject` | `string` | Whom the call is for: "user:<collection>/<id>", "guest:<id>", "guest:ip:<address>", "" or your own ("team:acme"). Change it to count the call elsewhere. |
| `user` | `{ collection: string; id: string } \| null` | The signed-in user the call is for, or null. |
| `guest` | `boolean` | The call is for a guest. |
| `input` | `Record<string, any>` | The operation's input (prompt, maxTokens, ...); change it as you like. |
| `guestsCapped` | `boolean` | Set it when this handler caps what guests may spend, so guest calls don't need a limit on all guests together. |
| `next()` | `(): void` | Lets the call go on. A handler that neither calls it nor throws refuses the call. |
| `refuse()` | `(message: string): Error` | An error refusing the call with your message (code "limit", 429): throw e.refuse("..."). |

### LlmCallDoneEvent

A call that reached a provider, as $llm.onCallDone handlers see it.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` |  |
| `op` | `string` |  |
| `model` | `string` |  |
| `subject` | `string` |  |
| `user` | `{ collection: string; id: string } \| null` |  |
| `guest` | `boolean` |  |
| `usage` | `LlmUsage` | What it used; usage.costMicroUSD is what it cost, in millionths of a dollar. |
| `job?` | `string` | A music or video job's id (its event comes once the job is done and its cost known). |
| `next()` | `(): void` |  |
